description.text: WEBER GRILL INCLUDED * OUTSIDE LANAI FURNITURE INCLUDED * WINE FRIDGE INCLUDED Experience active adult living in this meticulously upgraded CONTOUR floorplan located in the premier 55+ community Del Webb Naples. Imagine starting your mornings with coffee on your private lanai, watching the sun rise over the water while enjoying the peaceful sounds of nature. Welcome to 6138 Triumph Lane, one of the best values currently available in Del Webb Naples. Positioned on a tranquil lake with desirable northeast rear exposure, this beautifully maintained Serenity model offers the privacy, natural light, and indoor-outdoor lifestyle buyers seek in Southwest Florida. Wood-look tile flooring flows throughout, creating a clean, cohesive design that is both elegant and easy to maintain. The open-concept floor plan is ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, and a large island that naturally brings family and friends together. The adjoining dining and living areas seamlessly connect to the outdoor living space, allowing the lake views to become part of your everyday experience. The flexible den with custom barn doors offers endless possibilities as a home office, reading room, hobby space, or guest retreat. The split-bedroom floor plan provides privacy for owners and guests alike. The spacious primary suite offers peaceful water views, dual vanities, a large walk-in shower, and a generous walk-in closet. Step outside to the extended screened lanai and you'll quickly understand why homes like this are so sought after. The northeast exposure provides beautiful morning light while offering shade from the afternoon sun, creating a comfortable outdoor living space year-round. Unlike many villas within the community, this is a duplex villa, not a quad villa, offering enhanced privacy, fewer shared walls, and a more single-family-home feel. It is also one of the lowest-priced opportunities of its kind currently available in Del Webb Naples, and this floor plan is no longer offered by the builder. Life inside Del Webb Naples is centered around connection, wellness, and fun. Residents enjoy two clubhouses, resort-style and lap pools, a spa, fitness center, golf simulator, pickleball, tennis, bocce, and a full calendar of activities. The Rusty Putter Restaurant provides convenient dining, while Panther Run Golf Club offers optional championship golf. Just outside the gates, Ave Maria offers dining, shopping, parks, healthcare, live music, community events, and a popular weekly farmers market, all just a short golf cart ride away. This isn't simply a home, it's the lifestyle you've worked hard to create. Ave Maria - Once you get here, you get it.

description.text: CUSTOM SALTWATER POOL + SPA | 2.5 CAR TANDEM GARAGE and better than new! This 2023-built 5 bedroom + den + loft, and 4.5 bath home delivers the space, upgrades, and lifestyle buyers are looking for right now. Ave Maria ~ "Once you get here, you get it". Step outside to your CUSTOM 2024 SALTWATER POOL & SPA, finished with Diana Royal marble non-slip pavers and a panoramic picture screen overlooking the pond-private, peaceful, and designed for entertaining. LED color-changing lighting is fully remote controlled for day-to-night enjoyment. Child safe pool gate conveniently has 2 doors for easy access to and from pool area with additional childproof features for opening the doors. Another layer for pool safety is inside the home on the sliding glass doors. Both sliding glass doors have alarm/sound when the doors are opened. Inside, the home is thoughtfully upgraded with motorized shades on sliding glass doors and dual A/C systems for efficient comfort between upstairs and downstairs. The kitchen stands out with upgraded Bosch refrigerator and dishwasher, blending style with everyday function. Quartz countertops, pull out shelving in lower cabinets, and huge island make it a cooks dream for efficient space. Whirlpool range has air fryer feature, convect bake, and self cleaning! The utility tub in upstairs laundry room can be a life saver! The extra deep 2.5 tandem car garage is a MUST HAVE for extra space! Function meets convenience with an expanded paver driveway (an extra 2' on each side) for easier parking, loading, and added play space, plus additional pavers along the side yard. The 2.5 car tandem garage offers extra storage, flexibility, and room for a golf carts, and includes an additional refrigerator/freezer. Positioned across the street from a beautifully landscaped area-not another garage-this home offers a more open and attractive view. Move-in ready and available in time to be settled before the next school year, with multiple schools within walking distance. Living in Ave Maria is a lifestyle-beautiful parks, walking and biking trails, a vibrant town center with dining and shopping, year-round events, and a true sense of community that draws people here from all over the country.
